svg.title: Recovery tree
svg.desc: A behavior tree. The root, tag 1, is a selector named place_cell with memory on. Its three children, tried left to right, are: an EternalGuard named tester_1_ok, tag 2; the skill place_on_tester_2; and a Running behavior named hold_cell, tag 4, the last resort. Under the guard is a Retry decorator named retry_3 that allows 3 failures, tag 3, and under it the skill place_on_tester_1. Tree nodes are blue; skill calls are gray.

path.aria-label: children are tried left to right
